author: visegrad24
text:
🚨 BREAKING: Massive crowd of Iranian diaspora at the Cyrus the Great gathering in Toronto erupts into #JavidShah and #KingRezaPahlavi chants as His Majesty Iran’s exiled Shah @PahlaviReza enters the hall. 

More than 3,000 people and high-profile Canadians, including Conservative Party Leader @PierrePoilievre, participated.
